shared_elements: low relief carving of human figures in profile
bearded male figures with patterned headdress/hair
justification: Both show low-relief human figures in strict profile arranged in a directional line, rendered with schematic patterned hair/beard and stiff frontal-shoulder conventions, which is a modest stylistic convergence. But A depicts a tribute procession of men leading horned rams in a purely figural frieze, while B depicts a small arched tableau of figures flanking an altar-like structure beneath a large winged disc, above a huge block of dense inscription — different subjects, different compositional scheme, and no shared distinctive motif.
